race.comment: DEAL DONE FAST (3) is a fascinating runner for this Geelong Maiden. By Dundeel, he went around in the Australian Derby as a 20-1 shot and then the VRC St Leger. While beaten some way in those, he has been gelded and trialled with some intent. That ability just needs to be shown to win. DAME OF DUBAI (12) finished off OK at her first go. She is bred to want this sort of distance. Had a month between runs as well. LOVE 'N' GLORY (5) has come down from the Sydney Maher stable where he was OK. Bred to want two miles so monitor the betting. ZAMETOVKA (11) has plenty of important gear set for his first go and being a staying type from a top yard they know what is required. BRUTAL TEMPO (2) looks to be ready now third up.
